_readme: One entry per language code of the string catalog (en, fr, de, ja, zh-Hans, pt-BR...).
titles: the 5 titles of the Mac App Store screenshots 01 to 05, short and factual. No em dash or en dash.
demo: names the app does not translate because they are user data (GPU model, Bluetooth devices, disk names).
locale (optional): region used for dates and numbers, e.g. ar_AE; by default the language code with _ (pt_BR) or its usual country.
